_comment: How the Nahw notes behave when they are used as a test, same pattern as tamreen.json. The notes themselves never change: these say what is hidden and how much is asked at a time.
_comment-hide: Which kinds of marked piece start hidden in Test mode. Every role declared in the backend's roles.json can be switched on the page; these are only the ones on by default.
_comment-cards: Flashcards: how many in one run. Fewer than this in a topic simply means a shorter run.
_comment-reveal: Whether a hidden piece comes back for good once revealed, or hides itself again when the next one is opened. Coming back for good is kinder for reading; hiding again is stricter for drilling.
